description: Human-facing baseline prerequisites for PASI unattended browser automation. Conditional entries are not installed or authenticated automatically.

downloads.name: Python runtime / virtual environment
downloads.reason: PASI requires the repository virtual environment to run its Python services and automation supervisor.

downloads.name: Git
downloads.reason: PASI uses Git worktrees, verification, commits, and branch recovery.

downloads.name: Chromium or Google Chrome
downloads.reason: The native PASI ChatGPT controller requires a Chromium-family browser session.

downloads.name: PASI native Chromium extension
downloads.reason: Preferred browser-side controller and recovery path; install from automation/chromium/pasi-chatgpt.

downloads.name: PASI ChatGPT Controller Loader
downloads.reason: Alternative browser bootstrap for users operating PASI through Tampermonkey; use instead of a duplicate directly-installed controller.

downloads.name: Node.js
downloads.reason: Required to run the repository's JavaScript and browser-controller contract tests during development or CI mirroring.

logins.name: ChatGPT
logins.reason: The primary browser execution surface must already be authenticated for unattended prompts.

logins.name: GitHub
logins.reason: Required only for account-scoped repository actions or when the connected ChatGPT GitHub app is used as a fallback context source.

logins.name: OpenRouter
logins.reason: Conditional provider fallback when configured; PASI can continue with another route when this is unavailable.

logins.name: Perplexity
logins.reason: Conditional web-research fallback when configured; not required for core repository automation.

logins.name: Claude
logins.reason: Conditional provider fallback when configured; not required for the core PASI runner.
